canonical_binding.revocation_mechanism: Revoke by writing status=revoked on the G232 envelope at docs/architecture/formal_verification_authorization_replacement_approval.json with a new receipt_digest_sha256, or by superseding with a later-dated envelope that fails implementation_commit/tree binding; operators must fail closed on expired, wrong-tree, unsigned, or revoked envelopes.

purpose: Public-safe binding package prepared by the implementation agent for independent external legal/IP, security, and deployment-owner signers. This package is NOT a completed G232 approval. Signers must replace placeholder signature digests with digests of their independent signatures over the canonical binding body and set the official envelope to external_approval_complete only after three distinct human signers sign.

rules: Three distinct human identities required (no agent/bot/automation tokens in identity).
Each signer produces a signature over the canonical_binding JSON (sort_keys, separators comma-colon, ensure_ascii).
Record signature_digest_sha256 as sha256 hex of the raw signature bytes (or signed statement).
Do not set approval_complete until all three roles have signed the same binding.
Copy the completed envelope into formal_verification_authorization_replacement_approval.json only after signing.
Chat messages are not signatures; this package deliberately remains incomplete.
